svg.title: whoami — terminal
svg.desc: Animated terminal. whoami: Ankush, machine learning and software engineer. focus: vision-language models, LLM fine-tuning, model serving, backend engineering, event-driven systems, cloud infrastructure. models (fine-tuned): donut, qwen2.5-vl, qwen3-vl, qwen3. stack: python, kafka, postgresql, react, kubernetes, terraform, aws.

text.font-family: 'pMono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
